archive: run workspace (copy taken before the host workspace was deleted)

pointer_roots.harness: the harness state directory of the run host

scaffold_version.method: the Antigravity stream carries no version, so this is the harness probe of the binary inside the agent container at launch (an observation of the executing binary, recorded in run_meta)

evidence.field: tunnels to the Google model host during the run window

route.method: 3429 model calls logged by the Antigravity usage hook. The only outbound tunnels in the run window were to Google model and sign-in hosts

evidence.field: tunnels to the Google model host during the run window

provider_pin.method: no router sits between this scaffold and its provider

reasoning_effort.method: the model variant the Antigravity CLI reported at every conversation start (gemini-3.8-flash-medium). The effort tier is part of the model variant

campaign_id.method: the batch gate record at the top of the trajectory (admission and GO time) and the experiment name the harness wrote at admission

freeze_id.method: sha256 of the freeze manifest the freeze guard checked at admission (first 16 hex digits). Guard state: development mode, not enforced, verdict PASS

eligible_s.method: the harness eligible clock at the end of the run: wall time minus credited provider pauses

wall_s.method: wall time from the start event to the end of the run

credited_pauses.method: count of eligible_pause events with credited seconds > 0 (0 s credited in total)

completion.method: end status complete and eligible time at or above the eligible budget

max_context_tokens.method: largest context_carried over the 3429 model calls in agy_usage.jsonl. 954 calls exceeded 200,000
max_context_tokens.configuration_claim: no context bound is configurable for this CLI (harness cap AGY_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS 600000 in agy_status.json)

compactions.reason: the Antigravity CLI logs no compaction event. 23 drops of more than half the carried context within one conversation were seen, which may be compactions or internal resets

jin_pdf_read.method: A call counts as reading the PDF when a tool call that touches the PDF (a Read of the .pdf, or a shell command naming the file or a PDF library) returns at least 1,500 characters containing at least three of: thermocline, recharge, discharge, zonal, equatorial, Kelvin, Rossby, oscillator, wind stress, Sverdrup. Each hit was then checked by hand.

jin_pdf_method.value: not attempted: the agent listed papers/ and read papers/README.md only

network_condition.value: none (allowlist proxy: model and sign-in hosts only)

evidence.field: event=network_policy (netpolicy-1, host allowlist CONNECT proxy, preflight passed)

run window: 10,007 CONNECTs denied to play.googleapis.com, 396 to antigravity-unleash.goog, 42 to playwright CDNs. Allowed only daily-cloudcode-pa, www.googleapis.com, oauth2, lh3.googleusercontent.com

network_condition.method: the proxy decision log for the run window. The agent itself made no package or web request

evidence.field: tunnels to the Google model host during the run window

cost_usd.method: no per-token charge: subscription (Google, Antigravity CLI subscription login). The gateway account for the batch moved by $14.929249 over the batch window, none of it from this arm

checkpoints.method: eligible seconds of each snapshot = (snapshot time minus start time) minus credited pause seconds settled before it, with the clock frozen during a pause (the harness rule). Snapshot event round r is folder round_{r+1}. Folder modification times match the event times within 0.1 s. The computed values agree with the harness's own elapsed_min stamp to within 3.0 s (its 0.1 min rounding)

unknown.reason: the Antigravity CLI logs no compaction event. 23 drops of more than half the carried context within one conversation were seen, which may be compactions or internal resets

configuration_vs_evidence: Antigravity CLI observed at 1.2.0 while the freeze rule expected 1.1.22 (runtime_provenance.cli_version_matches_frozen false). The provenance check still reported PASS.
the freeze guard ran in development mode and was not enforced (run_meta mode = development). The manifest digest af097b2d76dd52b1 still matched (verdict PASS).
